duplication.desc: summarize copied whole into a new file
duplication.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
summarize_copy() {
  local total=0
  local count=0
  local largest=0
  for value in "$@"; do
    total=$((total + value))
    count=$((count + 1))
    if [ "$value" -gt "$largest" ]; then
      largest=$value
    fi
  done
  echo "total=$total count=$count largest=$largest"
}
